move.body:
Dear Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH team,

You have described Hollerau as an important reference customer, so it sounds like this project matters beyond the individual order. We value that relationship and will ensure reliable payment within the agreed terms. How could that payment certainty, together with the verified reductions in material and energy cost drivers, translate into a more competitive price?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,200 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 31.50 per unit (offer:70240-0). Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -8.5% from 2024-11 to 2025-10 (idx:AS-14404@2024-11, idx:AS-14404@2025-10). We have also put our invoice processing in order and will pay reliably on the agreed day.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 28.70 per unit, 45 days payment, 28 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Dear Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH team,

You have highlighted both available capacity and Hollerau’s value as a reference; it sounds like dependable new business is particularly valuable to you. We appreciate your hands-on approach for the new series and recognise that our late payments need to be replaced by reliable payment. If we pay faster and reliably, how much room does that create for a more competitive price?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,200 units per year for 24 months. That is a contract worth about EUR 152,838 a year. We have an offer at EUR 31.50 per unit (offer:70240-0). We have also put our invoice processing in order and will pay reliably on the agreed day. Straight talk: over the last 12 months we paid 93% of your invoices late, on average 11 days after the due date. That is on us, and it ends with this contract: every invoice paid on the due date, which brings your cash in about 11 days earlier than you are used to.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 30.25 per unit, 14 days payment, 28 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

That is on us, and it ends with this contract: every invoice paid on the due date, which brings your cash in about 11 days earlier than you are used to.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 30.25 per unit, 14 days payment, 28 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Hallo, thanks for being straight about the late payments, getting paid in 14 days makes a big difference for us right now. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? 

With the 4,200 volume and the quick cash, I can come all the way down to a price of €30.50 per unit. Our offer comes with a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. 

Let me know if we have a deal so we can get this rolling.

Gruß
Claudia Fuchsreiter
